what: Mistake: on the 11:42pm Pacific status update (07:42 UTC, 10 Nov) I treated the run as the 7:42am Pacific one, so I moved Monday's summary into the page archive a run early and wrote a morning step-back section then.
why: Mixed up 07:42 UTC with 7:42 Pacific. No data was wrong, only the timing of the archive move. Rule: the archive run is the one that fires at 15:42 UTC.
